purpose: Obtain the author's explicit choice for two internally inconsistent frozen-plan facts before any S6-E0 red contract, optimizer implementation or execution is prepared.

bound_frozen_plan.original_preservation_rule: The original frozen snapshot remains authoritative historical evidence and may not be edited or replaced. Resolution must be additive, versioned, hash-bound and separately frozen.

conflicts_requiring_author_choice.question: Which per-run FFE budget governs the 12-problem, 7-variant, 30-seed mechanism stage M?

option_recommended.consequence: Matches PROJECT_PLAN, preregistration, failure tree and the frozen aggregate totals; requires an additive amendment that supersedes only the 10,000D sentence in the synthetic-suite specification.

option_alternative.consequence: Matches the synthetic-suite sentence but adds 211,680,000 M FFE and requires versioned changes to the plan, preregistration, failure tree and all aggregate totals before execution.

conflicts_requiring_author_choice.question: Which timing and aggregation definition governs the primary H1 graph-recovery endpoint?

option_recommended.value: NMI at 25/50/75/100 percent fixed-budget checkpoints; problem-level median
option_recommended.consequence: Matches PROJECT_PLAN, preregistration, experiment matrix and failure tree and keeps the frozen H1 branch thresholds directly executable.

option_alternative.value: NMI at first valid activation and time-weighted median over later valid graphs
option_alternative.consequence: Matches the synthetic-suite sentence but requires versioned changes to four governing artifacts, a precise time-weighting formula and reconsideration of the frozen H1 thresholds.

B.meaning: Resolve the mechanism budget at 2,000D, retaining the currently frozen 52,920,000 M-FFE and 270,120,000 M+C1+F totals.

H.meaning: Resolve H1 at the fixed 25/50/75/100 percent checkpoints with the problem-level median NMI.

A.meaning: After B/H are chosen, create an additive amendment candidate, deviation entry, hash manifest and verification receipt; do not auto-freeze it.

R.meaning: Place the previous S6-E0 red-phase candidate on hold and issue a new version only after the consistency amendment is separately accepted and frozen.

G.meaning: Record local governance provenance only; do not configure a remote, push or publish.

E.meaning: Do not execute any optimizer, objective/constraint evaluator, benchmark, simulation, pilot, M, C1, F or C2.

F.meaning: Consistency resolution and amendment preparation create no run package and no formal FFE.

hard_stop_conditions: The author's B or H choice is absent, ambiguous or differs from the recorded candidate without an equivalent explicit decision.
Any original frozen artifact or snapshot byte would need to be edited or replaced.
The amendment changes any fact beyond the selected M budget and H1 timing/aggregation resolution.
Any S6-E0 specification, fixture, red test or production module is created before the amendment has its own hash-bound freeze acceptance.
Any objective/constraint evaluation, optimizer run, formal run package or formal FFE occurs.
Any performance, superiority, convergence, robustness, novelty, physical-validation or paper-readiness claim is inferred from the resolution.

supersession.note: The held candidate remains immutable historical provenance; it is not edited or silently treated as authorized.

completion_boundary.author_choice_means: The two conflicting facts have an author-selected intended resolution and amendment preparation may begin.
completion_boundary.author_choice_does_not_mean: The frozen plan is amended, S6-E0 red tests are authorized, an optimizer exists or any experiment may run.
completion_boundary.next_gate: Prepare and verify the additive plan-consistency amendment freeze candidate, then request separate author freeze acceptance.
